messages:
alice_support: Hey team — customer (tim_cust) reports streaming responses cut off after ~8s, client sees a 502 and then reconnect. Happens only when Cloudflare is in front of ALB -> origin. They included a curl repro and some pcap.
jordan_sre: Can you paste the exact curl you used? suspect ALB idle timeout or Cloudflare buffering.
tim_cust: curl they ran: `curl -v -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' 'https://api.prod.example/v1/stream?session=abc'` they say it prints a few events and then `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway` with no body, client tries to reconnect and resumes but loses the last token chunk.
alice_support: Uploaded their pcap to the ticket: shows `RST` from ALB side after ~8s of silence, but origin kept sending heartbeats. Cloudflare logs show `origin read timeout`.
maria_eng: Hmm — similar to earlier keepalive mismatch issues. Did the customer set `keepalive: 60s` on origin container? ALB default idle timeout is 60s, Cloudflare 100s? but we saw 8s here which is weird. Any proxies in front of origin (nginx/envoy)?
jordan_sre: They use envoy as sidecar (istio-ish) with `proxy_read_timeout` set to 8s in their helm values (surprising). That would explain the early cutoff. Tim, can you confirm envoy config?
tim_cust: Oof yes, we have `envoy.filters.network.tcp_proxy` with `idle_timeout: 8s` — didn't realize streaming traffic would be affected. We can change but need suggested safe fix.
alice_support: Quick mitigation: set envoy idle_timeout >= 300s for streaming routes; ALB idle timeout can be bumped too. Also try disabling any gzip/coalesce on upstream (some proxies will buffer until gzip chunk boundary).
maria_eng: Additional note—Cloudflare will buffer response bodies for some routes if it thinks resource is not streaming. Confirm `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and `Content-Type: text/event-stream` are present and not overridden by intermediary. Also ensure no `Content-Length` gets injected by nginx.
jordan_sre: For reproducible test, run: `curl -v -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' --no-buffer 'https://.../stream'` and tail origin logs. If you see origin sending data but envoy closing the connection with `downstream remote close` that's the tracer.
alice_support: I pushed a canary config to our customer-facing docs with recommended settings: envoy idle_timeout 5m, nginx `proxy_buffering off; proxy_request_buffering off;` ALB idle >= 120s, and add application-level heartbeats `:heartbeat\n\n` every 25s.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded to docs/cookbooks/streaming-proxies @alice_support (commit f3a2b7).
tim_cust: Thanks — we'll try the envoy change and report back. Do you want logs/pcap if it persists?
maria_eng: Yes please. If issue persists after envoy change, capture tcpdump on node and include ALB logs+Cloudflare Ray ID. We'll escalate to eng-runtime if we see kernel/TCP half-close patterns or Nagle coalescing.
alice_support: Great. Marking this thread persisted in ticket. Closing on our side pending your repro results. :thumbsup:
